sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: So here we are in the 99-Cent Store in West Oakland.
sentences.zh: 现在我们在奥克兰西部的99美分商店里。

sentences.en: Go into any dollar store in the United States and you'll find the same kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 走进美国任何一家一元店，你都会发现相似的商品。

sentences.en: They've already got the Christmas stuff out and like...
sentences.zh: 他们已经把圣诞商品摆出来了，而且……

sentences.en: Santa stuff everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是圣诞老人。

sentences.en: Little Santa booties that you can put on your baby.
sentences.zh: 可以套在婴儿身上的小圣诞老人鞋套。

sentences.en: A little Santa costume that you can put on a wine bottle.
sentences.zh: 可以套在酒瓶上的小圣诞老人服装。

sentences.en: In U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国的

sentences.en: dollar stores, there are grocery items and cleaning products and some of them are name brand iteMs.
sentences.zh: 一元店里，有杂货和清洁产品，其中一些还是知名品牌。

sentences.en: But then there's this other category of things for sale.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一类出售的商品。

sentences.en: Little bags of plastic festive gourds.
sentences.zh: 一小袋塑料节日葫芦。

sentences.en: A slotted spoon.
sentences.zh: 一个漏勺。

sentences.en: It's just, yeah, everything's like, this doesn't have a brand name.
sentences.zh: 就是，是的，每样东西都好像没有品牌名称。

sentences.en: Like, where is it from?
sentences.zh: 比如，这是从哪来的？

sentences.en: Toys and jewelry and knickknacks that seem to have a sort of generic cheapness to them.
sentences.zh: 玩具、首饰和小摆设，似乎有一种千篇一律的廉价感。

sentences.en: Loofas.
sentences.zh: 浴球。

sentences.en: Toys and very generic looking razors.
sentences.zh: 玩具和外观非常大众化的剃须刀。

sentences.en: Little fake plants.
sentences.zh: 小假植物。

sentences.en: Do I want this chocolate toothpaste?
sentences.zh: 我想买这个巧克力牙膏吗？

sentences.en: I don't think so, but...
sentences.zh: 我可不这么觉得，但是……

sentences.en: Dollar stores aren't just a U.S.
sentences.zh: 一元店不仅仅是美国的

sentences.en: phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 一种现象。

sentences.en: They're in Australia and the U.K.
sentences.zh: 它们在澳大利亚和英国。

sentences.en: They're in the Middle East and in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 它们在中东和墨西哥。

sentences.en: They're all over the world.
sentences.zh: 它们遍布全世界。

sentences.en: And a lot of that stuff, that generic cheap stuff that lines the shelves of these stores,
sentences.zh: 而许多这类商品，也就是陈列在这些商店货架上的那些廉价通货，

sentences.en: comes from one place.
sentences.zh: 都来自同一个地方。

sentences.en: A market in China called the Futian Market.
sentences.zh: 中国的一个市场，叫做福田市场。

sentences.en: The Futian Market, where all this stuff comes from, it goes on for miles, for miles and
sentences.zh: 福田市场，所有这些东西的来源，绵延数英里，数英里

sentences.en: miles of just these tiny little stores.
sentences.zh: 又数英里，全都是这样的小店铺。

sentences.en: That's documentary filmmaker Daniel Whelan.
sentences.zh: 那是纪录片导演丹尼尔·韦兰。

sentences.en: The Futian Market is about 43 million square feet, or around 10 times the size of the Mall
sentences.zh: 福田市场占地约4300万平方英尺，大约是美国商城

sentences.en: of America.
sentences.zh: 的10倍大小。

sentences.en: You could enter the market and walk around it for days and never see the same stall twice.
sentences.zh: 你走进市场逛上好几天，也绝不会两次看到同一个摊位。

sentences.en: Daniel and his co-producer Tobias Anderson-Ockerblum made a documentary film called Bulkland about
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔和他的联合制片人托比亚斯·安德森-奥克布鲁姆制作了一部名为《散货大陆》的纪录片，

sentences.en: the Futian Market and the city in China where it's located.
sentences.zh: 讲述了福田市场以及它所在的中国城市。

sentences.en: Yiwu.
sentences.zh: 义乌。

sentences.en: There's about 2 million people here completely dedicated to making this stuff for us, but
sentences.zh: 这里大约有两00万人完全致力于为我们制造这些东西，但

sentences.en: no one's ever heard of it.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人听说过它。

sentences.en: The city of Yiwu is about 200 miles southwest of Shanghai.
sentences.zh: 义乌市位于上海西南约200英里处。

sentences.en: It's a market city, so it's quite vibrant in parts, but it's not an incredibly livable
sentences.zh: 它是一个市场城市，所以在某些地方相当充满活力，但它并不是一个极其适宜居住的

sentences.en: city, an incredibly lovely green city.
sentences.zh: 城市，一个极其可爱、绿树成荫的城市。

sentences.en: It turned from a sort of bucolic mountain town to what kind of seems a cookie-cutter industrial
sentences.zh: 它从一个田园风光的山城变成了现在这样一个千篇一律的工业

sentences.en: city now.
sentences.zh: 城市。

sentences.en: In the late 1970s, communist China began to open itself up to capitalism.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代末，共产主义中国开始向资本主义开放。

sentences.en: It would no longer be illegal to run private businesses in China.
sentences.zh: 在中国经营私人企业不再是非法的。

sentences.en: The province of Zhejiang, where Yiwu is located, had a history of being a center for trade,
sentences.zh: 义乌所在的浙江省历来是贸易中心，

sentences.en: and the people there were eager to join the new economy.
sentences.zh: 那里的民众渴望加入新的经济。

sentences.en: The villagers spent all their sort of life savings on cheap industrial equipment and started
sentences.zh: 村民们把他们所有的积蓄都花在廉价的工业设备上，开始

sentences.en: producing items that were really easy to make, playing cards or Christmas decorations
sentences.zh: 生产那些极易制造的物品，比如扑克牌、圣诞装饰品

sentences.en: or wooden toys.
sentences.zh: 或木制玩具。

sentences.en: And soon, a market opened up in the city of Yiwu to sell these iteMs.
sentences.zh: 不久，义乌市便开设了一个市场来销售这些商品。

sentences.en: The market was just a street market.
sentences.zh: 这个市场最初只是个街头市场。

sentences.en: People started making Christmas decorations and arts and crafts.
sentences.zh: 人们开始制作圣诞装饰品以及工艺美术品。

sentences.en: More and more people started to come to this market, and that's how it's grown up.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人开始来到这个市场，它就是这样发展起来的。

sentences.en: This is Nigel Kropp.
sentences.zh: 这是奈杰尔·克罗普。

sentences.en: He's a British trader who lives and works in Yiwu, and he originally came to this city just
sentences.zh: 他是一名住在义乌并工作的英国商人，最初来这座城市

sentences.en: to have an adventure and teach English.
sentences.zh: 只是为了冒险和教英语。

sentences.en: So I started teaching at this English training center, and I was teaching adults, and they
sentences.zh: 所以我开始在这个英语培训中心教书，我教的是成年人，他们

sentences.en: were factory bosses and trading company bosses.
sentences.zh: 是工厂老板和贸易公司老板。

sentences.en: So little did they know, I was teaching them English, but at the same time, they were teaching
sentences.zh: 所以他们不知道的是，我在教他们英语，但与此同时，他们也在教

sentences.en: me how to do the business here, how it all worked.
sentences.zh: 我如何在这里做生意，这一切是如何运作的。

sentences.en: I used to do day trips to the food chair market, and they used to show me around.
sentences.zh: 我过去常常去食品批发市场做日间旅行，他们会带我到处看看。

sentences.en: The street markets grew and grew, and eventually came to encompass four huge buildings connected
sentences.zh: 街头市场越办越大，最终涵盖了四栋通过空中走廊、道路和停车场相连的巨大建筑。

sentences.en: by sky bridges and roads and parking lots.
sentences.zh: 每栋建筑都划分了不同的产品区域。

sentences.en: And each of the buildings is divided into different products.
sentences.zh: 你会有珠宝大楼、玩具大楼、工艺品大楼，以及

sentences.en: You'll have the jewelry building, the toy building, the arts and crafts building, and
sentences.zh: 服装大楼。

sentences.en: the clothing building.
sentences.zh: 每天都有数千名外国商人参观义乌这个庞大的市场。

sentences.en: Every day, thousands of foreign traders visit this massive market in Yiwu.
sentences.zh: 他们用中文讨价还价，寻找可以大宗采购的商品，以便卖给自己祖国的一元店

sentences.en: They're haggling in Chinese, looking for things to buy in bulk that they can sell to dollar
sentences.zh: 和其他小商贩。

sentences.en: stores and other vendors in their home countries.
sentences.zh: 一旦你走进去，它与普通的购物中心或商场有很大不同。

sentences.en: Once you get inside, it's a lot different to a normal shopping center or shopping mall.
sentences.zh: 这里有成千上万个市场店铺。

sentences.en: It's thousands and thousands of market stores.
sentences.zh: 这些市场店铺大约是五英尺见方。

sentences.en: These market stores are about five by five feet.
sentences.zh: 所以它们通常由一个人或两个人经营，他们坐在里面，周围

sentences.en: So they're usually run by one person or two people, and they're sitting in there surrounded
sentences.zh: 都是他们的产品。

sentences.en: by their products.
sentences.zh: 而且没有任何产品是零售的。

sentences.en: And none of the products are for sale.
sentences.zh: 你不能走进去说，我想要一个钥匙扣。

sentences.en: You can't go in there and say, I want one key ring.
sentences.zh: 你必须走进去说，我想要1500个钥匙扣。

sentences.en: You have to go in and say, I want 1,500 key rings.
sentences.zh: 这正是住在义乌的英国商人奈杰尔

sentences.en: That's exactly the kind of volume Nigel, the British trader who lives in Yiwu, is looking
sentences.zh: 去市场时所寻找的那种交易量。

sentences.en: for when he heads to the market.
sentences.zh: 我们需要寻找大众化的动物。

sentences.en: And we need to find generic animals.
sentences.zh: 好吧，比如海洋动物也可以。

sentences.en: Okay, like ocean animals is okay.
sentences.zh: 还有壁虎、蜥蜴。

sentences.en: Also gecko, lizard.
sentences.zh: 我们去市场，供应商会给我们一个价格。

sentences.en: We go to the market and the supplier will give us a price.
sentences.zh: 然后我们下单。

sentences.en: And then we do the ordering.
sentences.zh: 货物会运送到我的仓库。

sentences.en: The goods are delivered to my warehouse.
sentences.zh: 我的优势在于我是个西方人。

sentences.en: The niche I have is that I'm a westerner.
sentences.zh: 显然，我讲英语。

sentences.en: I speak English, obviously.
sentences.zh: 而且我拥有西方人的思维。

sentences.en: And I have the westerner.
sentences.zh: 我知道什么产品是卖不出去的。

sentences.en: I know what products I'm not going to sell.
sentences.zh: 我知道预期的质量标准。

sentences.en: I know the quality expected.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一件相当重要的事情。

sentences.en: It's quite an important thing, I think.
sentences.zh: 在福田市场，我的生意主要是批量销售电子圣诞老人礼品。

sentences.en: At the Futian market, my business is mostly bulk sales of electronic Santa gifts.
sentences.zh: 这是王小阳。

sentences.en: This is Wong Xiaoyang.
sentences.zh: 她在福田市场有一个摊位，里面摆满了成百上千个塑料圣诞老人。

sentences.en: She has a stall in the Futian market filled with hundreds and hundreds of plastic Santas.
sentences.zh: 我们在1992年开始做这门生意。

sentences.en: We started this business in 1992.
sentences.zh: 那是自我爸爸开始的。

sentences.en: That's when my dad started it.
sentences.zh: 一周七天，她都待在这个完全被圣诞老人包围的店铺里。

sentences.en: Seven days a week, she's in this shop completely surrounded by Santas.
sentences.zh: 冲浪的圣诞老人。

sentences.en: Santas surfing.
sentences.zh: 从烟囱里爬出来的圣诞老人。

sentences.en: Santas climbing out of chimneys.
sentences.zh: 戴着雷朋眼镜骑摩托车的圣诞老人。

sentences.en: Santas riding motorcycles with Ray-Bans on.
sentences.zh: 在开始做这门生意之前，我从未听说过圣诞节的概念。

sentences.en: Before we started this business, I had never heard of the concept of Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: I had no idea what it was.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，圣诞老人是一个非常慈祥的老人，会在圣诞节

sentences.en: To me, Santa is a very kind old man who slides through your chimney on Christmas
sentences.zh: 从你的烟囱滑下来，给你带来礼物、快乐和好运。

sentences.en: and brings you gifts and happiness and good fortune.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节是海外人士的节日，但对于我们中国人来说，我们并没有因此放假。

sentences.en: Christmas is a holiday for people overseas, but for us Chinese people, we don't get any time off for it.
sentences.zh: 王小阳和奈杰尔只是经济链条中的两个环节，这个链条发端于中国，

sentences.en: Wong Xiaoyang and Nigel are just two links in the economic chain that starts in China
sentences.zh: 终结于你当地的一元店。

sentences.en: and ends at your local dollar store.
sentences.zh: 那个经济枢纽无疑是义乌的福田市场，

sentences.en: The hub of that economy is certainly the Futian market in Iwu,
sentences.zh: 但整个浙江省都参与其中。

sentences.en: but the whole Zheozhang province is involved.
sentences.zh: 义乌周边的城镇都有各自的特产。

sentences.en: Neighboring towns to Iwu all have their specialties.
sentences.zh: 万圣节时，我们出口女巫扫帚。

sentences.en: For Halloween, we export witch brooMs.
sentences.zh: 有一个村子专门制作这些扫帚。

sentences.en: And there's one village that will make these brooMs.
sentences.zh: 有一个镇专门制造独轮车。

sentences.en: There's a town that just makes wheelbarrows.
sentences.zh: 你去某个镇买玩具、木制拼图或圣诞装饰品。

sentences.en: You go to a town for toys or wooden puzzles or Christmas decorations.
sentences.zh: 每个镇都有其专门的领域。

sentences.en: Each town has its niche.
sentences.zh: 而大部分这些小玩具和小摆设都是通过小型作坊生产的。

sentences.en: And most of these little toys and trinkets are being produced in small operations.
sentences.zh: 也许某个家庭能够买得起一台工业设备并雇佣几个工人。

sentences.en: Maybe a family has been able to buy one piece of industrial equipment and hire a few workers.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔的电影里有一个场景：一些外来务工人员坐在某人的车库里，

sentences.en: There's a scene in Daniel's film where some migrant workers are sitting around in someone's garage
sentences.zh: 把熔化的金属倒入固定在模具中的机器里，以此制作廉价的时尚首饰。

sentences.en: making cheap costume jewelry by pouring molten metal into a machine that's setting it in a mold.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把它们稍微打磨一下，扔进一个容器里。

sentences.en: And then they're sort of filing it down and chucking it into a container.
sentences.zh: 接着那天晚些时候，可能会有个家伙过来拿走那桶首饰，

sentences.en: And then later that day, a guy will probably come by us and grab that bucket of jewelry
sentences.zh: 把它带到镇上的另一个地方，由别人把它装进包装里。

sentences.en: and take it to a different part of the town where someone will put it into packaging.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天，他会回来把所有这些东西收走并带到市场上去。

sentences.en: And then the next day, he'll come back and pick all that up and take it to the market.
sentences.zh: 对于省里的许多人来说，这甚至不是他们的全职工作。

sentences.en: And for many people in the province, this isn't even their full-time day job.
sentences.zh: 这只是一项副业。

sentences.en: This is just a side business.
sentences.zh: 从20岁到80、90岁的每个人，都会在农田里干活，

sentences.en: Everyone from the age of sort of 20 to sort of 80 or 90, they'll work in the farm
sentences.zh: 然后晚上回来开始制作女巫的扫帚。

sentences.en: and then they'll come back at night and start making witch's brooMs.
sentences.zh: 这有点像英国工业革命时期的家庭手工业。

sentences.en: A bit like the cottage industry back in Industrial Revolution in England.
sentences.zh: 那是住在义乌的英国商人奈杰尔·克罗姆普甘。

sentences.en: That's Nigel Crompigan, the British trader who lives in Ewu.
sentences.zh: 英国花了两百年，中国只花了二三十年。

sentences.en: Where it took Great Britain 200 years, it's taken China 20, 30 years.
sentences.zh: 你可以在义乌看到这种超高速增长带来的影响。

sentences.en: And you can see the effects of this super fast growth in Ewu.
sentences.zh: 这座城市发展得如此之快，以至于它甚至没有时间建设基础基础设施。

sentences.en: The city grew so quickly that it still hasn't had time to build basic infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 你会看到整个社区没有道路，没有铺设好的路面，

sentences.en: You'll see entire neighborhoods without roads, with no paved roads,
sentences.zh: 因为他们迫切需要人们立刻搬进这些建筑物，

sentences.en: because they just need people to immediately move into these buildings
sentences.zh: 并在地下室开始制造东西。

sentences.en: and start making stuff in the basements.
sentences.zh: 搬到中国几年后，奈杰尔遇到了他的妻子杰西，一个义乌本地人。

sentences.en: A few years after moving to China, Nigel met his wife, Jessie, an Ewu local.
sentences.zh: 当我创办贸易公司时，她在市场里有一个卖包的摊位。

sentences.en: When I started the trading company, she had a booth in the market selling bags.
sentences.zh: 而且，她也是我的学生之一。

sentences.en: And also, she was one of my students.
sentences.zh: 杰西的家庭是义乌众多受益于中国转向自由市场经济的家庭之一。

sentences.en: Jessie's family is one of many in Ewu to benefit from China's turn toward a free market economy.
sentences.zh: 她想让我去吃点东西。

sentences.en: She wants me to go and eat something.
sentences.zh: 在楼上。

sentences.en: Upstairs.
sentences.zh: 我得去楼上吃点东西。

sentences.en: I've got to go upstairs and eat something.
sentences.zh: 有冰啤酒吗？

sentences.en: Got any cold beer?
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得我是这个家庭的一员。

sentences.en: I've always felt part of the family.
sentences.zh: 他们一直都接受我。

sentences.en: They've always accepted me.
sentences.zh: 他们总是让我感到非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: They've always made me feel very welcome.
sentences.zh: 我从未感到有任何不同。

sentences.en: I've never felt any different.
sentences.zh: 结束。

sentences.en: He got it as well.
sentences.zh: 他也买到了。

sentences.en: He got it.
sentences.zh: 他买到了。

sentences.en: Nigel's wife's great-grandparents can remember Ewu before it opened itself up to capitalism.
sentences.zh: 奈杰尔妻子的曾祖父母还记得义乌走向资本主义之前的样子。

sentences.en: We've lived here since we were born.
sentences.zh: 我们生在这里，长在这里。

sentences.en: We built our own house.
sentences.zh: 我们自己盖了房子。

sentences.en: In the old days, it was suffering.
sentences.zh: 过去的日子太苦了。

sentences.en: It was really terrible.
sentences.zh: 真的是太糟糕了。

sentences.en: That's Nigel's great-grandmother-in-law, Gong Jinxiong.
sentences.zh: 那是奈杰尔的曾外祖母，龚金雄。

sentences.en: Just mentioning the suffering time, I feel so sad I could cry.
sentences.zh: 只要提到那段苦日子，我就难过得想哭。

sentences.en: Life was so tough that a single sweet potato was divided into pieces for several meals.
sentences.zh: 生活太艰难了，一个红薯要分成好几顿吃。

sentences.en: In the old days, there were no cars.
sentences.zh: 过去没有汽车。

sentences.en: Now, a lot of people can afford luxurious sedans.
sentences.zh: 现在，很多人都买得起豪华轿车了。

sentences.en: I am so comforted by the change.
sentences.zh: 看到这些变化，我感到很欣慰。

sentences.en: Of course, capitalism has also taken its toll on China.
sentences.zh: 当然，资本主义也对中国造成了冲击。

sentences.en: I think globalization is ruinous.
sentences.zh: 我认为全球化是具有破坏性的。

sentences.en: When it's unchecked, like it is in places like Ewu, you see a landscape almost completely destroyed.
sentences.zh: 当它失去控制时，就像在义乌这样地方，你会看到这里的地貌几乎被完全摧毁。

sentences.en: You know, the mountains are all dug out.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，山都被挖空了。

sentences.en: There's people burning rubbish everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都有人在烧垃圾。

sentences.en: It's smoggy all the time.
sentences.zh: 到处都是雾霾。

sentences.en: And you're sort of like, for what?
sentences.zh: 然后你就会想，这一切究竟是为了什么？

sentences.en: And then you see why.
sentences.zh: 接着你便明白了原因。

sentences.en: It's people who spent years almost completely malnourished now being able to sit around with a giant family and all eat and have a lovely time.
sentences.zh: 曾经多年营养不良的人们，现在能够和一大家子人坐在一起吃饭，享受美好的时光。

sentences.en: But now, people in China who have been able to move out of desperate poverty want more than to just make a living.
sentences.zh: 但现在，那些摆脱了绝对贫困的中国人，想要的不仅仅是谋生。

sentences.en: And those people are demanding a better lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 这些人正要求获得更好的生活方式。

sentences.en: We are at the market every day, every day, every day.
sentences.zh: 我们每天都在市场里，天天如此。

sentences.en: It never changes.
sentences.zh: 情况从没变过。

sentences.en: That's Wang Xiaoyang again.
sentences.zh: 又是王晓阳。

sentences.en: Her business selling Santas has grown substantially since her father first started it in 1992.
sentences.zh: 自从她父亲1992年创业以来，她卖圣诞老人的生意已经有了巨大的发展。

sentences.en: It's allowed her family to move into the middle class.
sentences.zh: 这让她的家庭跻身中产阶级行列。

sentences.en: But it's also swallowing up her existence.
sentences.zh: 但这也在吞噬她的生活。

sentences.en: She's there seven days a week, from sunup to sundown.
sentences.zh: 她每周工作七天，从日出到日落。

sentences.en: Maybe everyone has some regret in their lives.
sentences.zh: 也许每个人的人生中都有一些遗憾。

sentences.en: If I got to do it again, I would study harder.
sentences.zh: 如果能重来一次，我会更努力地学习。

sentences.en: Then I would not have to rely on the business that my parents ran for my entire life.
sentences.zh: 这样我就不必一辈子依仗父母经营的生意了。

sentences.en: Like a lot of middle class Chinese people, Wang Xiaoyang wants something more.
sentences.zh: 就像许多中国中产阶级一样，王晓阳想要更多。

sentences.en: My dream is to travel all around the world.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是环游世界。

sentences.en: The first place I want to go is Egypt.
sentences.zh: 我想去的第一站是埃及。

sentences.en: This is a place I've wanted to go ever since I was a kid.
sentences.zh: 这是我从小就想去的地方。

sentences.en: She doesn't want to just sell Santas seven days a week until she's able to get her daughter to do the same thing and then continue on forever.
sentences.zh: 她不想每周七天都在卖圣诞老人，直到有一天让女儿也走上这条老路，然后子孙永远重复下去。

sentences.en: For now, though, Wang Xiaoyang just has to work harder because costs in China are going up and her profit margin is getting slimmer.
sentences.zh: 不过就目前而言，王晓阳只能更努力地工作，因为中国的成本在上升，她的利润空间正在缩小。

sentences.en: Our costs for workers in China is increasing yearly.
sentences.zh: 我们在中国的用工成本每年都在增加。

sentences.en: Every part of production, starting from the smallest fitting part to assembly costs, it's getting more and more expensive.
sentences.zh: 生产的每一个环节，从最小的配件到组装成本，都变得越来越贵。

sentences.en: As the cost of labour goes up, people seek out cheaper labour markets.
sentences.zh: 随着劳动力成本上升，人们开始寻找更便宜的劳动力市场。

sentences.en: Bangladesh, Vietnam, Laos, they're right there.
sentences.zh: 孟加拉国、越南、老挝，它们就在那里。

sentences.en: And they've got the facilities to do it.
sentences.zh: 而且它们具备相应的设施。

sentences.en: And they're ready to take that work.
sentences.zh: 它们已经准备好承接这些工作了。

sentences.en: And they are starting to take that work away from places like Iwu.
sentences.zh: 它们正开始从义乌这样的地方抢走这些工作。

sentences.en: The Chinese government is also interested in moving the country away from its reputation as the world's factory.
sentences.zh: 中国政府也希望改变该国作为世界工厂的形象。

sentences.en: They don't want to be where all of our junk comes from.
sentences.zh: 他们不想成为我们所有垃圾的出处。

sentences.en: They want to be the next South Korea or Taiwan or Japan that makes computers and cars and, you know, solar panels and things like that.
sentences.zh: 他们想成为下一个韩国、台湾或日本，制造电脑、汽车，还有太阳能电池板之类的高端产品。

sentences.en: But Iwu is the city that cheap junk built, or really only half built.
sentences.zh: 但义乌是廉价小商品造就的城市，或者说，只造好了一半。

sentences.en: The city grew so fast that basic infrastructure has not caught up to the growth.
sentences.zh: 这座城市发展太快，基础设施根本跟不上发展的脚步。

sentences.en: In the coming years, the people of Iwu will have to find ways to finish building their city.
sentences.zh: 在未来的岁月里，义乌人民将不得不找到办法建完全城。

sentences.en: And then new ways to survive as the global economy changes.
sentences.zh: 并在全球经济变化的同时，找到新的生存之道。

sentences.en: The world's dollar stores will continue to be full of plastic Santas and cheap trinkets of all kinds.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的美元店将继续摆满塑料圣诞老人和各种廉价小饰品。

sentences.en: But soon this stuff may be made in the basements and garages and factories of some other city.
sentences.zh: 但很快，这些东西可能会在其他城市的地下室、车库和工厂里生产。

sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由凯蒂·明格尔制作，合作制作人有谢里夫·优素福、艾弗里·特拉夫曼、柯克·科尔斯特德、萨姆·格林斯潘、埃米特·菲茨杰拉德、塔龙·马扎、德莱尼·霍尔，以及我，

sentences.zh: 罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.zh: 英文配音由肖恩·阮和克莱尔·舍恩完成。

sentences.en: This story was adapted from the film Bulkland by Daniel Whelan and Tobias Anderson-Auckerblum.
sentences.zh: 这个故事改编自丹尼尔·惠兰和托比亚斯·安德森-奥克瑟布伦的电影《散装乐土》。

sentences.en: The full film is about an hour long and includes a bunch of other really interesting characters that we couldn't fit into this radio piece.
sentences.zh: 完整电影时长约一个小时，其中包含许多我们在电台节目中塞不下的其他非常有趣的角色。

sentences.en: You really should see it.
sentences.zh: 你真的应该去看看。

sentences.en: It's called Bulkland.
sentences.zh: 它叫《散装乐土》。
